Third-party code bundled with the app (loaded only when needed):

qrcode.js - QR Code Generator 1.4.4 by Kazuhiko Arase, MIT License - https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator
           Draws the order QR code on the POS.

QR Code is a registered trademark of DENSO WAVE INCORPORATED.
zxing.min.js - ZXing ("zebra crossing") for JavaScript 0.21.3, Apache License 2.0 - https://github.com/zxing-js/library
           Reads product barcodes with the camera on the Inventory screen (only on browsers
           without their own barcode reader).
